Prices for the stay of Nov 2 to 4, 2026, as listed on September 28, 2026.

15 Toronto hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 28, 2026 for Nov 2 to Nov 4, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Toronto hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 15 Toronto hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Agoda at 2, Super.com at 2, Traveluro at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Billabook.com at 1, br.Bluepillow.com at 1 and dealbase.com at 1. These are the Toronto rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 11 of the 15 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at Toronto hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 20% ($28 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 19% at Toronto Don Valley Hotel & Suites to 22% at Nester Finn St. Lawrence Market. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
